title: Frost Theme Review
description: A documentation-led profile of Frost’s minimal visual system and pattern-led workflow for agency and portfolio sites.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped, documentation-led Frost WordPress theme profile from KreativWP.
highlights: The official listing describes a clean, minimal design aimed at agency websites
Documented patterns include hero and portfolio sections, calls to action, and testimonials
The stated use cases include business, personal-brand, and creative-project sites
bestFor: Agencies and creatives looking for a restrained, pattern-oriented base before they add their own content and system decisions.
researchScope: This profile checks Frost’s current WordPress.org listing and official repository. It records documented patterns and intended use cases rather than testing site builds.
caveats: No controlled install, pattern customization study, accessibility audit, or loading benchmark has been completed. Verify maintenance expectations and update cadence before standardizing on it.
